construct.quote: The putative T252 mutants were constructed from the wild-type pBL(CYP101) vector using Quick-Change mutagenesis (Stratagene, La Jolla, CA) with the following primers; 5’-GGCCTGGATAACGTGGTCAATTTC-3’, 5’- GGCCTGGATAACACGGTCAATTTC-3’, and 5’- GGCCTGGATGCGGTGGTCAATTTC-3’ (only forward primers shown, the underlined bases denote mutated codons). The change in nucleotides was confirmed by sequencing. The open reading frames (ORF) for P450cam mutants including a 6 × His carboxyl-terminal tag were cloned into the pCW(Ori+) expression vector using the NdeI and XbaI restriction sites as previously described [12].

preparation.quote: Expression and purification of P450cam mutants were carried out as previously described with some modifications [13]. The E. coli strains transformed with pCW(Ori+) vectors were inoculated into TB medium containing 100 µg/ml ampicillin and 1.0 mM IPTG. The expression cultures were grown in 1 liter Fernbach flasks at 37 °C for 3 h and then at 24 °C with shaking at 200 rpm for 24 h. The solid camphor was added to the culture 1 h before harvest (200 mg/liter). The soluble proteins were separated by ultracentrifugation and purified using the Ni2+-nitrilotriacetate and DEAE Sepharose columns as described previously [14,15]. The fractions containing the 47 kDa protein were pooled and dialyzed with 20 mM phosphate buffer (pH 7.4).

partners.quote: Camphor oxidation by wild-type P450cam and its mutants was determined using the P450/Pd/PdR system [16]. The reaction mixture contained 200 pmol purified P450 enzyme, 1 nmol Pd, and 200 pmol PdR, in 0.50 ml of 100 mM potassium phosphate buffer (pH 7.4), along with a specified amount of the substrate. The reactions were initiated by the addition of 50 µl of 10 mM NADH. Incubations were generally done for 10–30 min at 37 °C and terminated by addition of 0.5 ml of CH2Cl2, followed by vortex mixing and centrifugation. The lower organic layer was transferred to a clean tube and analyzed by GC-MS

product_identity_method.quote: Analyses were performed on an Agilent 6850 gas chromatograph coupled to an Agilent 5973 Network Mass Selective Detector in the flame ionization mode as previously described [17]. Helium was used as the carrier gas. The GC was equipped with an HP-5MS cross-linked 5% PH ME Siloxane capillary column (30 m, 0.25 mm i.d., 0.25 µm film thickness). The temperature program was 70 °C for 1 min and then 70–280 °C at 15 °C/min or 70 °C for 5 min, 70–160 °C at 5 °C/min, and then 160–280 °C at 20 °C/min. The temperatures were 250 °C for the injection port and 280 °C for the detector. A sample of 3 µl was injected in a 10:1 split ratio onto the column. Identification of camphor and 5-exo-hydroxycamphor was done by co-chromatographic and mass spectrometric comparison with authentic standards.

product_conditions.quote: Camphor oxidation by wild-type P450cam and its mutants was determined using the P450/Pd/PdR system [16]. cofactor_conditions.quote: NADH oxidation rates for P450cam enzymes were determined in steady state kinetic experiments using the P450/Pd/PdR system in a 1:5:1 ratio, respectively. The P450/Pd/PdR system was preincubated for 5 min at 37 °C in the presence of camphor (2 mM). The reactions were initiated by addition of 10 µl of 10 mM NADH. The decrease of A340 was monitored and the rates were calculated using Δε340 = 6.22 mM−1 cm−1.

reported_product_activity.meaning: Source product report on its supported rate scale; a qualified native zero is not physical absence.

reported_cofactor_activity.meaning: Source cofactor-consumption report; reporter turnover alone does not establish productive chemistry.

reported_coupling_percent.meaning: The author-reported coupling statistic on percent scale, preserving original source meaning.

product_per_cofactor.meaning: Descriptive identified-product per consumed-cofactor comparison of selected source rates.

reconstructed_product_activity.meaning: Same-source product-rate reconstruction; original product contribution, not independent validation.

productive_fraction.meaning: Stoichiometric productive fraction of the selected reaction system, distinct from molecular attribution.

calculated_coupling_percent.meaning: The same productive-fraction component displayed in percent.

displayed_coupling_difference_pp.meaning: Displayed-rate arithmetic minus author-reported coupling in percentage points; no rounding/error penalty inferred.

product_per_cofactor_variance.meaning: First-order variance of the descriptive ratio under the supplied joint selected-estimate covariance.

productive_fraction_variance.meaning: Fixed-nu first-order productive-fraction variance; conditional fixed-substitution term when nu is uncertain.

productive_fraction_standard_uncertainty.meaning: Square root of the same fixed-nu variance term, not a confidence interval or function probability.
